help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Short answers to the most common questions.
help.q1: How do I translate a word or a phrase?
help.a1: Open “Translate” and type — the translation appears by itself. For a single word a full card opens below with meanings, examples and forms.
help.a2: Cards are words you want to remember. Tap “Add to cards”, then review them on the “Learn” tab — that is how words stay in memory.
help.q3: Where are my Gemini and Groq keys?
help.a3: Keys live only on your device (Profile → “My AI keys”). In an account the key is stored encrypted.
help.q4: Why does “Ask AI” sometimes not work?
help.a4: Shared site keys have a daily limit. Your own free Gemini or Groq key removes it.
help.q5: How do I install the app on my phone?
help.a5: On iPhone open the site in Safari, tap “Share” → “Add to Home Screen”. On Android: menu ⋮ → “Install app”.
help.a6: Yes, once installed: history, favorites, cards and exercises work offline. Check it in Profile → “Check offline readiness”.
help.a7: The site detects the language itself. If you prefer, turn “Detect language” off in your profile and pick it manually.
help.q8: How do I look up a word in the dictionary?
help.a8: The “Dictionary” tab searches Wiktionary, OpenThesaurus and PONS. The translator card appears right under the translation.
help.q9: Why is a translation sometimes wrong?
help.a9: The fast translation comes from regular translators, which can be wrong on rare words. Use “Accurate translation (AI)” or “Explain”.
help.a10: The text goes to the translation service and comes straight back. History and favorites stay in your browser by default; in an account they sync between devices.
